title: 番外欧阳舒晚第1章 无名的河番外柳月第3章 月圆
content_zh:
只是让霍阳没想到的这次他在聚气阵中修炼却是越来越感觉不对劲儿，因为仅仅是几个时辰过去，他居然感觉聚气阵中心位置的仙气又比平时少了一成，这样的情况绝对不正常。
看来这些裂空岩鳄知道龙炎很强大，所以一出手，就是绝对杀招。
同理，流云宗和太虚门那些金丹强者联手对付他，也是这个原因，因为叶枫表现的太逆天，太妖孽，让他们心生恐惧，就如同当年的“不败老祖”。
长刀直插而进，锋利的刀刃瞬间刺穿毒蝎会士兵的身体，鲜血顺着伤口喷涌而出，直接溅了李炎一脸。
听到这话，魏明不由脸色微微变了变，对着叶枫上上下下打量几番，随后便轻松下来。
“去查！找到那个桑塔，同时分派人手出去搜索，一定要把那个杀人凶手找到。”大尊者开口道。
作为各大酒楼的老板，收入的暴跌、顾客数量的急剧减少，他们都看在眼里。
但却并没有真的扎进去，而是在离他身体一尺处的地方被一层无形的能量给挡了下来，那些飞剑密密麻麻的如同刺猬一般，却都在那里静止了下来。
苏盛晨就好像站在古罗马的斗兽场，身穿着角斗士的战甲，面对着这样或那样凶猛的敌人。
“既然出手了，便不能让你活着离开这里。”晋天在出手的时候就已经下了决定，此人他定要斩杀在这里，不然后患无穷。
当赤兔龙马、方天画戟、貂蝉全部都在吕布体内，就算是在没有吕布元神的情况下，依旧能爆出鬼神力，甚至是更强的魔神力。
猪血要是搁后世又叫液体肉、血豆腐、血花，动物血通常被制成血豆腐是最理想的补血佳品之一。
我心想这都是管制用品，向伟就没想过带这些东西出门是犯法的吗？
并且它们好似真被什么操控一样，正直冲冲的向着车队方向涌来。
“没事没事，你忙就行。”苏洪林被这一声“我成年了”震得不轻，略微有些尴尬的摆了摆手。
同时，张封正准备出屋询问护卫，问问那二百里外是什么乡镇的时候。
于是，我随着陈方圆几人来到之前进入大厅的洞口，我看见地上散落着一些罗盘符纸之类的东西，想必是陈方圆他们此前因为情急而扔下的。
如果算上被天魔吕布感染的四象圣主，这天下的圣主已经死的差不多了。世人第一次发现，原来圣地圣主竟然是这么高危的职业，动不动就要被崛起的年轻一代强者给打死。
须知何致远的发作很突然，他距离笑傲天又近在咫尺，在场的众人又都还处于笑傲天被一招打败的震惊中，根本还没缓过神来。
无名僧人面色大变，他独臂难支，还未来得及挣脱山体，金色光芒在他脖颈处绕了一圈，人头落地。

“你还真会藏东西。”扬抱着胸口，扯了扯运动衣，将自己裹了个严实。
“嘻嘻，谢谢。”苏雪接过碗，微微一笑，随即埋头吃了起来，没有再继续刚才的话题。
吸收了第一日会议的教训，第二日的会议在来自联合国的主持引导下有条不紊地进行着，一切与本日会议主题无关的议题，在提出之前也被告知需要等到明天，也就是第三日的综合讨论中再进行商谈和解决。
一众将领激动不已，就差没有把长泽当成神了，他们看长泽的眼神也变了，再不是之前看孩子似的眼神，而是疯狂的、崇拜的，佩服的……当然，还有慈爱和羡慕。
信中，纪云开表达了对“贺礼”的震惊，直言告诉纪大人，以后不要再送了，她和她的孩子都不需要。
风云卷动，斗转星移，山河色变……可怕的金凤神通术，不断朝白夜砸轰下来！而此刻的白夜，也是将最强的战斗“装备”全部了亮出，已处于最强战斗状态。
话没说完，佟宴忽然用力的咳嗽了起来，是刚才还没来得及咽下去的饭给卡在了嗓子眼里。
楚一点点头，找了张椅子坐下，巫青则坐在旁边把玩着翡翠镯子。
“我自然是有我的打算。”夜紫菡只是笑了笑，带着北冥云进了屋里。
凌空走在路上，担心皇城内有金丹后期及其以上的修炼者，看到凌空这样肯定会有所怀疑，便直接遁入地下。
许志魔正待在升仙台一角，独身一人皱着眉头，不知在想些什么，此时骤然看到江逸然来临先是一怔，随后立刻化成惊喜。
一转眼就新年二月了，他从阴箓派盗取的灵草药材都消耗完了，修练也差不多了，而化龙决不能继续闭关，是该出去云游走走，求仙问道，寻找道法，以及化龙入葬的物件。
不过气愤归气愤，自己的肚子却也是不争气地叫唤了起来，都那么久没有吃东西了，能不饿吗？
“不好，他身上有诡异，那不是属于他的力量，趁他没有完全解放力量一起压制他。”玄武龟忽然说道。
本来戴安娜与墨白合作，是因为双方互助互利的关系，她利用墨白身为玄力者的能力，而墨白也可以利用她对游乐场比较熟悉，但是很不巧，墨白因为太过优异所以自己根本帮不上什么忙。
顿时，暗裔之奴仿佛受到了毁灭性的打击，整个面孔因为剧烈的疼痛而开始扭曲，与陈静对轰的拳头瞬间发出惨烈的骨折声，庞大的身躯仿佛不堪一击，往煤山处滚去。
司天宫，昊天镜里，画面丝毫未变，但司天天君却是眉头一挑，清晰得感应到，画面失去了灵性，昊天镜失去了搜寻的目标。
如今又遇、白云揉碎银沙飞，玉屑奓开雪絮堆，琼霙飘逸気飔飔，宵宵清冷凊寒，单枕孤衾独自睡，番番旧梦使憔悴。
：8xiaoshuo。：wap.8xiaoshuo

What Huo Yang didn't expect was that this time he felt more and more wrong while practicing in the Qi Gathering Array, because just a few hours later, he actually felt that the immortal energy in the center of the Qi Gathering Array was 10% less than usual. This situation is definitely not normal.

The long knife plunged straight in, and the sharp blade instantly pierced the body of the Poisonous Scorpion Soldier. Blood spurted out from the wound and splashed directly into Li Yan's face.
Hearing this, Wei Ming couldn't help but change his face slightly, looked at Ye Feng up and down several times, and then relaxed.
"Go and check! Find that Sangta, and at the same time assign people to search. We must find the murderer." The great venerable said.
As the owners of major restaurants, they have seen the plummeting income and the sharp decrease in the number of customers.
But it didn't really penetrate. Instead, it was blocked by a layer of invisible energy one foot away from his body. Those flying swords were densely packed like hedgehogs, but they all stopped there.
Su Shengchen seemed to be standing in the Colosseum in ancient Rome, wearing a gladiator's armor, facing one or another fierce enemy.
"Now that I have taken action, I cannot let you leave here alive." Jin Tian had already made up his mind when he took action. He must kill this person here, otherwise there will be endless troubles.
When Red Rabbit Ryoma, Fang Tian Hua Ji, and Diao Chan are all in Lu Bu's body, even without Lu Bu's soul, they can still explode ghost power, and even stronger demon power.
Pig blood is also known as liquid meat, blood tofu, and blood flowers in later generations. Animal blood is usually made into blood tofu, which is one of the most ideal blood-enriching products.
I thought to myself that these are controlled items. Didn't Xiang Wei think that it was illegal to take these items out?
And they seemed to be controlled by something, rushing towards the direction of the convoy.
"It's okay, it's okay, just be busy." Su Honglin was shocked by the words "I'm an adult" and waved his hand slightly embarrassed.
At the same time, Zhang Feng was about to leave the house and ask the guards what town was two hundred miles away.
So, I followed Chen Fangyuan and others to the entrance of the hall where I had entered before. I saw some compass talismans and other things scattered on the ground, which must have been thrown away by Chen Fangyuan and others out of desperation.
If we include the Holy Lord of the Four Symbols who was infected by the demon Lu Bu, almost all the Holy Lords in the world are dead. For the first time, the world discovered that the Lord of the Holy Land turned out to be such a high-risk profession, and he would be beaten to death by the rising young generation of strong men at every turn.
It should be noted that He Zhiyuan's attack was sudden, he was very close to Xiao Aotian, and everyone present was still in the shock of being defeated by Xiao Aotian with one move, and had not recovered at all.
The face of the unknown monk changed drastically. He could not support himself with one arm. Before he could break away from the mountain, golden light circled around his neck and his head fell to the ground.
"You are really good at hiding things." Yang hugged his chest, pulled on his sportswear, and wrapped himself tightly.
"Hehe, thank you." Su Xue took the bowl, smiled slightly, and then started eating without continuing the topic.
Having absorbed the lessons learned from the first day's meeting, the second day's meeting was carried out in an orderly manner under the auspices and guidance of the United Nations. All issues unrelated to the theme of today's meeting were told before they were raised that they would need to wait until tomorrow, which is the third day's comprehensive discussion, to be discussed and resolved.
The generals were so excited that they almost regarded Nagasawa as a god. The way they looked at Nagasawa also changed. They no longer looked at him like a child, but with crazy and worshipful eyes., admiration...of course, there is also love and envy.
In the letter, Ji Yunkai expressed her shock at the "congratulatory gift" and bluntly told Mr. Ji not to send any more gifts in the future, as neither she nor her children needed them.
The wind and clouds are turbulent, the stars are moving, the colors of mountains and rivers are changing... The terrifying golden phoenix magical power is constantly slamming down on Bai Ye! At this moment, Bai Ye also displayed all his strongest combat "equipment" and was already in the strongest combat state.
Before he finished speaking, Tong Yan suddenly coughed hard. The food he had not had time to swallow just now was stuck in his throat.
Chu nodded and found a chair to sit down. Wu Qing sat next to him and played with the jade bracelet.
"Of course I have my own plans." Ye Zihan just smiled and led Bei Mingyun into the house.
Lingkong was walking on the road, worried that there were practitioners of late Jindan or above in the imperial city. Seeing Lingkong like this, he would definitely be suspicious, so he hid directly underground.
Xu Zhimo was staying at the corner of the Shengxian Platform, alone and frowning, not knowing what he was thinking. When he suddenly saw Jiang Yiran coming, he was startled at first, and then immediately turned into surprise.
In the blink of an eye, it was February of the new year. The spiritual herbs he had stolen from the Yinlu Sect were all used up, and his training was almost done. Hualong could not continue to retreat. It was time to go out and wander around, seek immortality, search for Taoism, and the objects for Hualong to be buried.
However, he was angry, and his stomach growled unsatisfactorily. He hadn't eaten for so long, how could he not be hungry?
"No, there's something weird about him. That's not his power. We should suppress him while he doesn't fully release his power." Xuanwu Turtle suddenly said.
Originally, Diana and Mo Bai cooperated because of the mutually beneficial relationship between the two parties. She took advantage of Mo Bai's ability as a mysterious power user, and Mo Bai could also take advantage of her familiarity with the amusement park. Unfortunately, Mo Bai was too good, so he couldn't help at all.
Suddenly, the dark descendant slave seemed to have suffered a devastating blow, and his entire face began to distort due to severe pain. The fists clashed with Chen Jing instantly made a tragic fracture sound, and his huge body seemed to be vulnerable to a blow, and rolled towards the coal mountain.
In Sitian Palace, the picture in the Haotian Mirror did not change at all, but Si Tiantianjun raised his brows and clearly sensed that the picture had lost its spirituality, and the Haotian Mirror had lost its search target.
Now we meet again, white clouds crush the silver sand and fly away, jade flakes scatter in the snow piles, Qiong Kuo floats elegantly, the night is cold and cold, I sleep alone with a single pillow in a solitary quilt, haggard from old dreams.
